scenarios.name: Bull
assumptions: 1.6T optical transceiver transition accelerates across Tier-1 cloud hyperscalers throughout CY2027
EML laser capacity debottlenecking drives gross margin expansion above 53.0%
Optical Circuit Switching (OCS) reaches over $150M quarterly revenue milestone
Multiple expands toward peak semiconductor infrastructure comps (48x) on sustained >50% profit growth

scenarios.name: Base
assumptions: FY2027 net revenue reaches $5.84B with non-GAAP operating margin holding steady at 40%
800G shipments remain solid while 1.6T transceiver volume ramp progresses per management timetable
Balanced supply-demand environment with stable component pricing and disciplined OpEx
Multiple stabilizes near 40x FY2027 consensus EPS

scenarios.name: Bear
assumptions: Hyperscalers initiate a multi-quarter AI CapEx digestion cycle, moderating optical transceiver order rates
Laser fab expansion delays and packaging yield constraints push high-volume 1.6T deliveries into late FY2028
Competitive pricing pressure in standard 800G transceivers compresses operating margins to ~34%
Multiple de-rates to 26x as forward revenue growth decelerates toward cyclical hardware peers
